meta.title: One bid: award all 10 units to Vendor A; approver approves without a remark
gaps: Sign in as the approver, leave the approval remark empty, click Approve, and verify the refusal message "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the approver, leave the approval remark empty, click Approve, and verify the refusal message "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly in Master QCS as required for this state.
Verify the bid quantity is the expected 10 units.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate is 100.
Verify the grid calculates 10 × 100 as the line amount and total.
Open the awarding screen for the closed bid.
Allocate the available line to Vendor A.
Assert that all line items and exactly one vendor are selected for award.
Create and submit the award proposal for Vendor A after allocation.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted, ready for approval.

args.need: sign in as the approver, open the submitted proposal, leave the approval remark empty, click Approve, and verify the refusal message "Remark is necessary for approval" while the proposal remains pending

steps.note: A separate approver session and the no-remark approval attempt are required to test the requested refusal.
Assert that the proposal remains pending approval after the refused no-remark approval attempt.
